note: The row taxonomy for D3 (backend mechanism matrix). Rows are CAPABILITIES/MECHANISMS, never modules: codex ships 104 crates and grok ~90, but many are infrastructure (ansi-escape, async-utils, build-info, xai-ratatui-*) whose presence or absence says nothing about capability. Module counts are also not comparable across sources, so a module-to-module table would be both noisy and misleading.

domains.label: Agent 循環與輸入模型
domains.scope: The turn/step engine and how new input enters it: loop shape, per-session serialization, input tiering, steering, interruption, abort semantics, turn budgeting.

domains.label: 會話與持久化
domains.scope: Event log and its projections, replay, durability, crash repair/recovery, schema migration, session lifecycle, ownership locking.

domains.label: 上下文與壓縮
domains.scope: Context-window resolution, token accounting, compaction/summarisation strategy, pruning, shadow projection, budget ladders and their failure modes.

domains.label: 工具與執行
domains.scope: Tool registry and exposure model, schema validation, parallel execution and commit ordering, timeouts/retries/repeat guards, output spill, file patching and diffing, process/PTY control.

domains.label: 子代理與多智能體
domains.scope: Delegation protocol and its durability, task state machines, cancellation trees, depth/concurrency quotas, background execution and parent wake, team/roster coordination, identity.

domains.label: 沙箱與權限
domains.scope: OS-level confinement backends and what each actually restricts, read vs write isolation, approval flow, danger classification, escalation ladder, permission rule models, hooks as gates.

domains.label: 模型與供應商
domains.scope: Wire protocols, model catalogue and discovery, context/max-output metadata, reasoning-effort translation, provider registry and resolution chain, credential handling and auth.

domains.label: 擴展面
domains.scope: MCP client/server, LSP, skills, hooks, plugins and marketplaces, workflow engines, scheduling, todos and goals as durable extension state.

domains.label: 服務與 API
domains.scope: Transport surface for external consumers: HTTP/WS, streaming and replay, SDK wire contract, ACP, app-server/RPC, authentication of the service itself.

domains.label: 檢索與記憶
domains.scope: Session search and lineage, full-text indexes, cross-session memory, codebase graphs, file search, attachment/multimodal ingestion.

domains.label: 可觀測性與運維
domains.scope: Telemetry and event manifests, diagnostics, cost and token accounting, feedback channels, crash handling, distribution/update, benchmarking.

domains.label: 介面與呈現
domains.scope: LIMITED TO THE BACKEND INTERFACE per the approved scope: only the seams where the presentation layer meets the engine — the event/stream contract a renderer consumes, screen-mode policy, and capability detection. Rendering internals, layout and theming are OUT of scope.
